title: Neon Mushroom Terrarium
description: A glowing spherical glass terrarium sits on a metallic base, containing a vibrant neon mushroom with dripping pink liquid. Bright cyan, purple, and green leaves and roots extend from the central mushroom, illuminated from within against a dark background with floating particles.
prompt: A spherical glass terrarium glowing with neon purple light, containing a central mushroom with a pink dripping cap and vibrant glowing turquoise and green leaves connected by glowing roots. Liquid drips down the glass surface. The orb rests on a dark metallic base with engraved text. Dark background with floating luminous particles, surreal digital painting style.
